subject: Post-call: Trial onramp plan & evaluation guardrails
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novushealth.com>

Subject: Post-call: Trial onramp plan & evaluation guardrails

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the concrete next steps so we can get the 4-week trial running without friction. I pulled together a short onramp checklist (attached) and a draft SOW for procurement.

Top-line success criteria we heard from you:
- End-to-end extraction accuracy >= 92% on the two pilot forms (claims intake + prior auth) measured by the evaluation rubric we discussed.
- Median generation latency under 250ms for 256-token responses during peak traffic (sample sized to 1000 requests).
- No PII persisted beyond session (KV cache disabled for pilot).

Proposed trial plan and owners (please confirm):
- Week 0 (this week): Contract signature + invoice / PO in place (Procurement)
- Week 1: Dedicated sandbox + onboarding call (Redwood: Ben Carter; Novus: you + engineering lead)
- Week 2: Dataset ingest and eval run (Redwood: Monica Patel)
- Week 3: Iteration on prompts/thresholds and short A/B check (Redwood: Markus Klein)
- Week 4: Acceptance run and final readout (Redwood: Marissa Cole)

Attachments: novus-onramp-checklist.xlsx, redwood-sow-draft.pdf — the checklist maps the minimum artifacts we need from your side. Please: 1) confirm the Novus owners for each item, 2) flag anything missing from the success criteria, and 3) let us know the PO cadence so we can align timing.

If that looks good I’ll drop the SOW in DocuSign and Ben will schedule the onboarding slot.

Thanks — Mark
--
Markus Klein | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Markus, thanks for the concise summary — this lines up with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

Confirmed Novus owners:
- Procurement / PO: Priya Natarajan (cc'd)
- Engineering lead for sandbox & data ingest: Priya will loop in Rajesh Kumar (engineer)
- Clinical SME for acceptance criteria: Dr. Lena Morales (will join evaluation readout)

Success criteria notes:
- Accuracy target: we can accept 90% for the first run with a mutual remediation plan to reach 92% by final readout. If we see consistent model drift we may ask for a short extension.
- Latency: 250ms target is fine, but please note our integration will simulate bursts at 5rps as part of the acceptance test.
- Data handling: Procurement will need a short note on retention & logs for our security review.

I attached the security questionnaire that our InfoSec team requires prior to onboarding. Also: can you push the SOW redline to me so procurement can start review?

Appreciate the clarity — Alex
